strings.notes: 努 not in 0719; US contact Hiker Anthony (US 0711)

strings.zh: 话说回来,{SCROLL}我是一个登山男,{NEWLINE}所以经常要爬山！{SCROLL}反倒是镇里不常去！{SCROLL}看你这样子,应该是在{NEWLINE}经常在各个城市之间旅行吧。{SCROLL}既然如此,那我们就{NEWLINE}交换一下电话号码,{CLEAR}相互交换各自的情报吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: By the way, I’m a Hiker, so I’m always{NEWLINE}climbing mountains.{SCROLL}I don’t usually go to the town.{SCROLL}I bet you go to all kinds of towns on{NEWLINE}your journey, don’t you?{SCROLL}You know, if we were to trade phone{NEWLINE}numbers, then we could exchange all{CLEAR}kinds of information, yes? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0711/1 | RV073: addition: removed added 'and caves'

strings.zh: 等我想到那些暖心窝的话后,{CLEAR}我会打电话告诉你的！
strings.en: I’ll give you a call when I think of a{NEWLINE}good, heart-warming story, OK?

strings.zh: 你说话这么无情,{NEWLINE}小心我把你留在山里。
strings.en: Talk that heartlessly and I might just{NEWLINE}leave you stranded in the mountains.

strings.zh: 怎么样？{NEWLINE}和喜欢冒险的同伴{CLEAR}交换一下电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: What do you say?{NEWLINE}Would you like to exchange numbers{CLEAR}with another adventurer? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 都这么近了还要打电话？{SCROLL}大叔我就⋯⋯{NEWLINE}那么耀眼吗？
strings.en: You’re nearby, and yet you’re going to{NEWLINE}call me on the phone?{SCROLL}Is this old guy really... that{NEWLINE}“dazzling”?
strings.notes: US 0711/5 | RV073: voice: kept 大叔我 self-reference; removed added 'keep your distance'

strings.zh: 前段日子{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}我找来了很多{CLEAR}看起来很好吃的果实,{CLEAR}于是,我就和它一起吃了！{SCROLL}虽然不知道这东西能不能吃⋯⋯{NEWLINE}但真的很好吃。{SCROLL}你自己保重！
strings.en: The other day, my {VAR:0100:10} found me{NEWLINE}lots of tasty-looking Berries, so we ate{CLEAR}them together!{SCROLL}I’m not sure if they were even edible...{NEWLINE}but they were really delicious.{SCROLL}Take care!

strings.zh: 最近我经常能遇到{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}！{CLEAR}别担心,我把它秒了。{SCROLL}你多保重！
strings.en: Lately, I’ve been running across wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} quite often.{CLEAR}They’re easily taken care of.{SCROLL}All right then!{NEWLINE}Be good!

strings.zh: 对了,前不久我在和{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}战斗的时候,{CLEAR}被一旁路过的{CLEAR}成熟大姐吸引,{CLEAR}结果被它给逃走了。{SCROLL}你对战的时候一定要集中精神啊！{NEWLINE}请多保重！
strings.en: Oh yeah, I was battling this {VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}the other day... It took off when I got{CLEAR}distracted by an attractive older woman{CLEAR}passing by.{SCROLL}Learn from my mistake--always stay{NEWLINE}focused on the job at hand!{SCROLL}All right then! Be good!
strings.notes: US 0711/8 | RV073: meaning: 成熟大姐 = mature older woman, not the Beauty class; settles D-1904

strings.zh: 让我们现在来场精灵对战吧！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}等你养足了精神就来吧。
strings.en: Come on, let’s have a{NEWLINE}Pokémon battle right now!{SCROLL}I’m at {VAR:0104:3}. Come{NEWLINE}over once you’re rested up.

strings.zh: 喂喂！{NEWLINE}难道你忘了{SCROLL}和我进行精灵对战的约定了？{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Hello! You haven’t forgotten about our{NEWLINE}battle, have you?{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3}! I’m waiting!

strings.zh: 说起我为什么会如此喜欢山呢,{SCROLL}喜欢栖息在山中的精灵{NEWLINE}的确是其中一点,{CLEAR}但最为重要的,{CLEAR}就是我喜欢山本身。{SCROLL}我实在不理解为什么{NEWLINE}有那么多人喜欢大海⋯⋯
strings.en: I wonder why I like mountains so much...{SCROLL}It wouldn’t be wrong to say I also like{NEWLINE}the Pokémon that dwell on mountains.{SCROLL}But I bet that the number one reason is{NEWLINE}that I just like mountains.{SCROLL}I really don’t get why so many people{NEWLINE}like the sea...
